That changes it: INT is fixed at 32-bit signed range (-2,147,483,648 to 2,147,483,647), and the display width is orthogonal to capacity -> INT(11) can't hold 12-digit numbers because INT maxes out at ~2.1 billion (10 digits), not because of the parentheses.

My reasoning was backwards. The parentheses are formatting only. The limit comes from bit size.

grade.note: Assistant correctly accepts that INT is fixed 32-bit and display width is unrelated to capacity.
